family.description: Invoker ruling of 2026-10-29: the tuned arm's report gains the shared stage probe, and the probed arm alone records batch fill on the FI-2 confirmation cells as a descriptive record. It compares nothing, makes no ledger reservation and neither repeats nor alters the confirmation, whose verdicts stand. Each cell of the frozen FI-2 confirmation plan runs as 5 replicate cells whose baseline and candidate are the probed tuned arm, each dispatched once in the runner's validation position; every execution reports conversion.batch_fill_ns from the arm's zero-iteration stage probe. Validation dispatches open no ledger, so ledger_path names a file the record never writes.

effect.rationale: Ten percent whole-call improvement is material for this integrated route; the canonical freezer requires the margin above one plus the pilot resolution.
effect.equivalence_rationale: Invoker ruling of 2026-10-28, made before any confirmation sample: the pilot resolution invalidates the pre-pilot margin, so the margin becomes the smallest two-decimal value that strictly exceeds one plus the resolution. Pilot resolution 0.06; pre-pilot equivalence margin 1.05.
effect.material_gap_rationale: The family has no comparator-gap cell.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: Zero added source lines and zero unsafe kernels: the family measures committed arms under the committed envelope, and its outcome retains or withdraws that envelope's decode selectors.
